problem_text:
A logistics company needs to coordinate 3 cargo shipments through 3 different distribution hubs.

Each shipment follows a specific route represented as pairs (Hub, Handling duration),
where each pair specifies the hub where the cargo must be processed and the time required for handling.
The order of pairs indicates the mandatory sequence in which the cargo must pass through the hubs.

Shipment details:
* S1 follows the route: (H2, 2) → (H1, 2) → (H3, 6)
* S2 follows the route: (H2, 7) → (H1, 6) → (H3, 10)
* S3 follows the route: (H3, 8) → (H1, 9) → (H2, 5)

Each cargo handling operation must run continuously once it begins and cannot be interrupted,
and each hub can only process one cargo shipment at a time.
The objective is to determine the processing sequence of all cargo shipments at the hubs
so that the total completion time for all shipments is minimized.
